title: Harden legacy adviser prediction normalization and finite-score fallback
body: Audit 001 demonstrated malformed/nonfinite/overflow inputs escaping or corrupting legacy adviser normalization. Audit 051 finds ten relevant functions unchanged at local origin/main 7fa363d0e93bbfc623e1ee3bf773a2f663649c17 and verifies the guarded CLI -> TasteAdvisor -> OpenResearcher path. This is conditional legacy relevance, not a current failing run or a selected P8 defect. Evidence: results/integration-audit/20261115-001 and results/integration-audit/20261115-051/PUBLICATION.md. Separate owner should define the normalization/fallback policy, preserve evidence thresholds, add targeted malformed/NaN/Inf/overflow regressions, and repair the legacy path only after applicable live-run locks permit autoresearch edits. Do not repeat unchanged probes for another count or silently alter scientific policy. No live-model run is required for the repair.
